dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High visibility; sharp, pale off-white boundaries along the margins of the folded flight feathers against darker grey-brown centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct transition from the solid dark grey-brown crown to the highly contrast-scalloped mantle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Identification bands present on the left leg, including one red band and one metallic silver band.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive and uniform scalloped pattern across the entire dorsal surface created by pale feather fringes.
